title: Grateful Dead Live at International Amphitheatre on 1973-02-19
lineage: SBD : MC > C > DAT > SS > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of the Feb 19 1973 Chicago second set delivers a smoking He's Gone → Truckin' → The Other One → Eyes of the World → China Doll medley with strong jams, good overall sound but occasional drop‑outs.
ai_review.review: The show is hailed as one of the best second‑sets of ’73, highlighted by an epic jam that weaves He’s Gone into Truckin’, a monster Other One and a marathon Eyes of the World that resolves into China Doll. Reviewers praise Jerry’s closing “eyes”, Phil’s soaring bass solos and Bob’s tight rhythm work, while noting a few recording hiccups—a cut before Eyes and some muddy drop‑outs at the start of that song—yet the soundboard source is generally clear and enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (4–5 stars) praise the musical performance and jams, while recording quality is described as good with minor flaws; weighted averaging yields a solid 4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced sound, but some reviewers note an unfortunate cut before Eyes and muddy drop‑outs at the beginning of that song.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A powerful second set with a seamless, extended jam sequence; despite a brief cut the flow remains tight and exhilarating.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for closing his ‘eyes’ on the Eyes of the World/China Doll transition and delivering solid lead work throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Repeatedly highlighted for spectacular bass licks, “Phil zone” moments, and being a standout in February ’73.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for strong rhythm guitar playing, especially during the early Eyes jam.
